name: GTM Gig Finder
description: Sprint 15 gig lane: forum notification mail, HN (off) and manual adds become gig_posts; fixed gates and scoring, LLM reply drafts to the review console, hot-gig Discord ping, gig_ops stats.

parameters.query:
select post_key, platform, url, title, body_text, poster, poster_company, gtm_iso(posted_at) as posted_at, reply_count, 'manual' as __source
from gig_posts
where status = 'new' and (platform = 'manual' or gig_score is null)
  and coalesce(posted_at, first_seen_at) > now() - interval '14 days'
order by first_seen_at desc
limit 50;
select post_key, status from gig_posts where status in ('drafted','sent','replied','won','lost','expired');

select g.post_key, g.platform, g.url, g.title, g.body_text, g.poster, g.poster_company, gtm_iso(g.posted_at) as posted_at,
       g.reply_count, g.contact_email, g.contact_hint, g.stated_budget, g.remote_hint, g.matched_stack, g.intent,
       g.gig_score, g.score_breakdown
from gig_posts g
where g.status = 'new' and g.gig_score >= $1::int
  and coalesce(g.posted_at, g.first_seen_at) > now() - make_interval(hours => $2::int)
  and not exists (select 1 from outreach_queue q
                  where q.lead_track = 'gig_post' and q.account_id = 'gig:' || g.post_key
                    and q.approval_status in ('pending','edited','approved','needs_redraft'))
order by g.gig_score desc, g.posted_at desc nulls last
limit $3::int;

parameters.content:
## GTM Gig Finder
Sprint 15 gig lane (ADR-114 to ADR-116). Finds public posts where someone hires an n8n, Clay, HubSpot or automation freelancer, gates and scores them with fixed rules, drafts one short reply per good post, and puts the drafts in the review console. Nothing is sent by the system.

**Sources** (Phase 0: the forums forbid automated access)
- Read Forum Mail: the forum's own notification emails. Off until you add a Gmail OAuth2 credential, set the n8n community Jobs category to Watching First Post and label the mails `gtm-gigs` with a Gmail filter. Then enable the node.
- Load Manual Gigs: posts you add on the console Gigs page.
- HN Freelancer Source: off in config (no hiring posts in 4 months).

**Run:** manual, from GTM Run, or every 3 hours once you publish it (D7).
**Results:** gig_posts and gig_ops in Neon; drafts in the console Queue (track Gig).
**On failure:** GTM Engine: Error Alerts.

Colors: green = free, rule-based, orange = calls an LLM, blue = human step, gray = setup and telemetry

## 1 · Sources
Forum notification mail, HN (off) and manual adds. Every source returns a marker item when it has nothing, so Merge Posts always runs.

## 2 · Gate, score, store
Fixed gates in order: seen, intent ([FOR HIRE] posts never get drafted), freshness, crowding, veto, stack, budget. Every drop is counted. All posts are upserted (gated ones too, for dedupe), old ones expire, then the best new posts without a live draft are selected.

## 3 · Draft, ping, telemetry
Draft Gig Reply uses the engine's LLM router (copied, ADR-115) and the gig validator: words, two specifics from the post, stack whitelist, no seniority claims, no invented numbers, no links (code adds them), one next step, no money. One repair retry, then needs_redraft. Hot posts (score 75+) ping Discord with title, platform, age, score and link only. One gig_ops row per run.
